verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's get-started docs list official SDKs for Go (github.com/sandbox0-ai/sdk-go), Python (pip install sandbox0) and TypeScript (npm install sandbox0), authenticated with a team API key. The Python SDK also ships an adapter that makes Sandbox0 the backend for the OpenAI Agents SDK, and other docs reference SDK-driven workflows. missing for 10: in-depth SDK API reference or examples in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
